text:
Aisha: hey infra — can someone take a quick look at my PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123
Aisha: it's a small schema change to analytics.events (add `session_type` ENUM + nullable) + a batched backfill job for the last 90 days. PR has migration + backfill job in `etl/` 
Derek: on it, pinged in my queue. quick q: does this change any primary key or sharding?
Aisha: no pk changes, still (event_id, ingestion_ts). We do add an index on (session_type, event_type) for the new dashboard query. index creation is CONCURRENT.
Jon: fyi the streaming consumer (events-processor) reads events.* by column projection — will this break consumers if column order changes?
Aisha: shouldn't — we add a column, do not reorder. consumers using SELECT * may see new column but it handles extra columns. I added a note in PR about the consumer owners and a short migration checklist.
Priya: quick safety thing — can we run the backfill in smaller batches to avoid long table locks? you mentioned batched job but not size.
Aisha: backfill batches are 1h windows (approx 100k rows) and use LIMIT/WHERE with indexed timestamp. I also added a feature flag `enable_session_type_backfill` to gate the heavy job.
Derek: looks reasonable — two small comments in code: 1) rename var `batch_start` -> `window_start` for clarity, 2) add explicit retries for last page of backfill.
Aisha: thanks — updated. also added a short smoke test script: `scripts/check_session_type_counts.sh` (see PR).
CI-Bot: build passed on linux/mac, integration tests flaky: `etl::backfill::integration` failed once, rerunning.
CI-Bot: rerun succeeded.
Jon: can you also add a note in the release notes about the new index and potential increased write amplification for the analytic path? just a one-liner under DB changes.
Aisha: will add. also tagging @data-team for awareness in the PR description.
Priya: LGTM modulo Derek's nits. agree we should schedule migration in maintenance window — any preference?
Derek: next maintenance slot is Tue 04:00 UTC. Recommend we merge after midnight, run index create as CONCURRENT, then start backfill flagged off, flip the flag when ready.
Aisha: plan: merge PR after approvals, create index during window, start backfill with flag off, monitor `etl-backfill` consumer CPU and replication lag, flip flag when stable. I will post runbook steps in the PR.
Priya: I'll take primary reviewer and sign off once you address Derek's nits.
Derek: small code nits fixed, re-reviewed, approved.
Priya: approved.
Aisha: thanks all — scheduling the merge for Tue 04:10 UTC and I'll post final runbook.
deploy-bot: Automated schedule created: migration-window Tue 04:00 UTC -> Tue 05:00 UTC (ticket INFRA-789).
Aisha: leaving this thread open for any last calls. :thumbsup:
